review.notes: CineGuide is a TV listings guide. No login is required. Listings are loaded from https://konechoco.github.io/programmi-tv/epg/ (refreshed every 6 hours). To test the in-app purchase: gear icon (Settings) > Go Pro > Buy; 'Restore purchases' is on the same screen. Reminders: open any upcoming programme > Remind me > choose a time; a local notification is scheduled. Ads are served by Google AdMob after the Google UMP consent form (EEA) and the App Tracking Transparency prompt (iOS); Pro users see no ads.
